method: Manual review of screenshots produced by the final real Chromium run after settled UI.
findings: Global conditions are visually separated from product management and expose one clear editor action.
Group conditions show inheritance state, effective rules and a read-only catalogue with one aggregate edit action.
Desktop and 390px mobile layouts have no overlap or horizontal overflow; untrusted catalogue text remains literal.
limitations: Manual screenshot review, not pixel-diff coverage; files remain in ignored local E2E artifacts.
